what: 40 textured city_block crops, 4 per class, ground truth from the scene's own geom names via a MuJoCo segmentation pass. No detector was involved in the labels.
note: PNGs are resized to a 384 px longest edge from the full renders; source_sha256 is the digest of the original .npy the renderer wrote, so a re-render is checkable against the pool digest.
thumbnail_note: thumbnail_b64 is the EXACT bytes MapEntry.thumbnail would hold: camera_channel.ingress._encode_thumbnail applied to the full render (64 px longest edge, <=16 KB). Committed so the CI eval needs no image decoder — .parcel carries no Pillow — and so the row 1-3 replay uses the crop the SHIPPING path would see.
